text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Since I'm standing on the same 
stage as the Umamusume, I need to get 
stronger too...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I want to join the battle for 
1st place and feel the intense clash of my 
faves closer than anyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"My oshi panting during the final spurt... 
I wanna inhale her carbon dioxide! I'll 
photosynthesize ittt!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...I-It's not just frustration... I feel 
miserable about myself..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to be strong enough not to 
bring shame to the other Umamusume, too...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You're right...! I want to be someone my 
favorite can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Polishing oneself is also part of a fan's 
'fandom duties'! All for the sake of my 
fave!"
